summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and the private helper _resolve_path (standard library only). Lines are within 120 columns by measurement. Not verified: tests were not run, and black/flake8 were not run, so a few multi-line raise expressions may be reflowed. No commits were made.
